english.title: Aid abet counsel and procure a person in the making / supplying of an article for use in fraud

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: designed for use in the course of fraud
adapted for use in the course of fraud

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) aided, abetted, counselled and procured, **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), in their

(A)_[making of]_
(B)_[adaption of]_
(C)_[supply of]_
(D)_[offer to supply]_

an article, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ARTICLE..),

(E)_[knowing that it was designed or adapted for use in the course of or in connection with fraud]_
(F)_[intending it to be used to commit, or assist in the commission of fraud]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 7 of the Fraud Act 2006 and section 44 of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
aided abetted counselled procured a person
in their making / adaption of / supply of / offering to supply an article
knowing that it was designed/adapted for use in the course of/in connection with fraud OR

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 8 of the Fraud Act 2006 provides that article includes any program or data held in electronic form.
(ii) Section 12 of the Act makes provision for directors, managers, secretaries or other similar officers or person purporting to act in such a capacity to be liable to prosecution where a body corporate has committed this offence.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Twelve months imprisonment and/or fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

For offences committed before the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the penalty is six months imprisonment and/or fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

INDICTMENT: Ten years imprisonment and/or fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
